adjudication.rationale: In the diff, the admin embedding UI (app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs) only invokes `addHost` and host-level actions via the `embeddable-host` component; there is no template control wired to `saveChanges`. The client action `saveChanges()` (admin-embedding.js.es6:6) calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but the server `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (embedding_controller.rb:10-12) ignores params and just re-renders the serializer, so even if called it performs no state change. Given the rest of the behavior (create/update/destroy hosts handled by Admin::EmbeddableHostsController and `host.save()` in the component), the PUT route/controller/action appear unused and redundant based on what’s shown, which is a cleanup/architecture issue rather than a functional defect.
